justification: Removes content from a paid surface and deletes a paid-tier feature listing. The Sentinel-2 adjacent-lot construction check is withdrawn from the shadow product entirely: it returned a reading in 0 of 538 stored reports while all 538 rendered a confident negative about neighbouring land, and at 20 m SWIR a suburban lot is about one pixel, so even working it measures roughly 30-40 properties at once. Beyond the render surfaces this deletes a COMMERCIAL REPRESENTATION: the landing page sold 'Surface-change screening detail' as free:false/paid:true beside a $29 price, logged as DQ-52 before removal. Critical tier because content leaves a paid PDF and a paywall comparison table, and because deleting services/sentinel2.py is irreversible without a revert.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest --testPathPattern=shadow-removal-consumer-check  THEN  grep -rniE 'construction_change|compute_change_score|surfaceChangeState|bare.soil' services scripts src frontend-nextjs
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The consumer check RENDERS each surface rather than reading source. It calls buildFindings and asserts no finding mentions the removed check while the findings list stays non-empty, so removal cannot be faked by emptying it. It renders ShadowDisplay and asserts both the absence of the wording AND that the card's last element still has content, which fails if removal left a trailing empty block. It asserts the landing config sells nothing it cannot do, that features.length is exactly 3 (the value that triggers lg:grid-cols-3 and prevents an empty fourth cell), and that the paid comparison row is gone. It goes red if any surface regains the wording, if the findings list collapses to empty, if a hole opens at the end of the card, or if a fourth feature is added without revisiting the grid. The grep is the negative-claim evidence and must return only Pre-DA History's unrelated ds_sentinel2 audit labels plus the two stored-data measurement scripts.

pre_impl.existing_data: property_reports WHERE product='shadow' - 538 rows, READ-ONLY, no writes in this PR. Every row carries construction_change_score/_detected/_note; measured state today: 292 legacy exact-0.0, 241 with a note, 5 null score, and ZERO that would render a real reading. The stored fields are deliberately left in place - they are the historic audit trail, and scripts/measure_shadow_calibration_damage.py must keep being able to re-verify the 0/538 finding.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The section 4h surface list was written from a census and was INCOMPLETE - it named the PDF, free tool, Brief, report page and map, and missed five commercial/documentation surfaces including the paid-tier listing. Verified independently against origin/main before editing. Two claimed surfaces do NOT render the check: ShadowMap.tsx and app/reports/shadow/** both return zero matches.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Pure removal. No new capability, no DA-feed replacement built. The one added file is a consumer-check test. FeatureGrid gains a conditional column count rather than a second grid component.
pre_impl.external_source_error: One fewer external dependency: the shadow pipeline no longer calls Element84 at all, so the 25s timeout path, the ThreadPoolExecutor and the 'Insufficient cloud-free scenes' branch are gone with it. Pre-DA History's own Sentinel-2 usage is a separate code path and is untouched.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Types narrowed: construction_change_score/_detected/_note and s2_latest_acquisition removed from ShadowReportData, ShadowOutputs and ShadowData; the Brief's ShadowServiceOutput and ShadowScenario models drop the same three. tsc --noEmit: 0 errors.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A stored report that used to render 'Surface-change check: not assessed' now renders nothing in that slot. Verified not to leave a hole: PDF and tool findings are .map() over an array, the Brief card's last element still carries content, and the landing grid drops to lg:grid-cols-3 so no empty cell appears.

functions.name: buildFindings
functions.input: the ShadowReportData for one stored or freshly computed shadow report, read for its scenarios, adg_compliant verdict, modelled height and zone
functions.output: the Finding[] the paid PDF renders as its findings list - one fewer entry now that the surface-change finding is gone
functions.if_none: Cannot be None. An empty array would render a findings section with no rows; the consumer check asserts the list stays non-empty so removal cannot be faked by emptying it.

values.guard_at: asserted in the consumer check: 'Surface-change screening detail' must not appear
values.if_missing: The row is gone, so the paid tier no longer advertises a capability the product does not have. This was DQ-52.

values.guard_at: FeatureGrid branches to lg:grid-cols-3 at exactly 3; asserted in the consumer check
values.if_missing: At 4 columns with 3 cards the desktop grid would show an empty fourth cell - the hole the ruling required closing. Verified no other landing page changes: bushfire 6, conveyancing 8, flood 8, intelligence-brief 9, pre-da 8, solar 4, threat-radar 4 all keep grid-cols-4.

queries.purpose: Count which state each stored report would render before removal (read-only; no writes in this PR)
queries.if_zero: Exits 2 rather than reporting no damage - an unread corpus is not a clean one.
queries.if_wrong: The connection is opened readonly, so a wrong predicate cannot mutate anything; the script is retained precisely so the 0/538 finding stays re-verifiable after the feature is gone.

break_it.scenario: A future session re-adds a satellite change check to shadow because services/CLAUDE.md still describes one.
break_it.what_happens: The 0/538 detector returns, along with the per-parcel attribution the sensor cannot support.
break_it.how: The Shadow Detector section of services/CLAUDE.md now records the removal, the 0/538 measurement and the 20 m SWIR physics, and says shadow queries no satellite imagery at all. The Threat Radar section's false 'same Sentinel-2 pipeline' claim - which is what made the original surface census short - is corrected with the grep result.

break_it.scenario: Removal leaves an empty space where the section was, which a reader interprets as 'nothing to report'.
break_it.what_happens: An absence that looks like a clear result - the same class as the em-dash defect #885 fixed.
break_it.how: The consumer check renders each surface and asserts the findings list stays non-empty, the Brief card's last element still has content, and the landing grid drops to 3 columns so no empty cell appears.

break_it.scenario: Pre-DA History breaks because it was assumed to share the deleted Sentinel-2 module.
break_it.what_happens: A live product loses its imagery timeline.
break_it.how: Grep-verified before deletion: pre_da_history.py never imports services/sentinel2.py - its ds_sentinel2 is a DataSourceQuery audit label for its own Element84 calls. The only importers were shadow_detector.py and one test, both handled.

break_it.scenario: The field-coverage ratchet is loosened to let the removal through, so a FUTURE accidental field loss also passes.
break_it.what_happens: The ratchet stops protecting every other model.
break_it.how: Only the six construction_change_* entries were removed from scripts/brief_field_coverage_baseline.json; the ratchet logic is untouched and its own unit tests (field loss, rename, model disappearing) still pass. Any other field loss still fails.

post_merge.db_reset: No schema change, no migration, no data write. The 538 stored reports keep their construction_change_* keys as historic audit; nothing renders them.
post_merge.secrets: None added or removed. One external dependency is dropped - the shadow pipeline no longer calls Element84's Sentinel-2 catalogue, which required no credential.
post_merge.other_repo: No change needed elsewhere. plotdetect-agents does not call the shadow pipeline's S2 path.
post_merge.manual_verify: Open a stored shadow report on the live site and the paid PDF and confirm: no surface-change section, no empty space where it was, the scenario table and ADG finding still render, and the landing page shows three feature cards with no gap and no 'Surface-change screening detail' row in the pricing table.
